A [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] served as the '''commander''' of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] battle [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Eclipse (Harrower-class)|''Eclipse'']] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] and [[Death/Legends|died]] defending the vessel from the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]].
